family.title: The family weekend
why: Saltwater, private to your family, and fenced all the way round with a gate. Open May to September.
Pool, grill, table and fire table sit together behind the house, so you can cook and still see the water.
Nothing to gate off and nobody to carry up. A gas fireplace and a television for the rainy hour.
Stocked with the basics, an island for pancakes, and a dishwasher for afterwards.

girls.title: The girls’ weekend
why: The king suite makes a getting-ready room: its own bathroom, a soaking tub and a door that closes. The valley’s vineyards are minutes away.
A long farm table for the tiles, the cards or the puzzle, with the kitchen right behind you and room for six around it.
Wineries, a cidery and breweries along Route 151, then back to the fire table with whatever you bought.
A hot tub facing the ridge, a pool in season, a porch swing, and nobody asking you for anything.

golf.title: The tee-time weekend
why: A gas grill, a counter and a place to eat outside. Barbecue utensils are provided.
Where the round gets replayed, shot by shot.
For backs and shoulders, in every season.
Mountain golf at Wintergreen one day, Old Trail or Birdwood the next. The house sits between them.

trail151.title: The Route 151 weekend
why: The house sits in the Rockfish Valley on Route 151, so the first stop is minutes away.

A farm table and bench for six, with wine glasses in the cupboard.
For the cheese, the bread and whatever else came back with you.
A last glass by the fire
Outside at the fire table, or inside by the gas fireplace.

outdoors.title: The trail and snow weekend
why: Ski, tube or hike at the resort by day, then come down to a whole house, a real kitchen and your own hot tub.
The valley is your dinner menu
Barbecue, pizza, breweries and wineries along Route 151, instead of the same few places at the top of the mountain.
Open in every season, facing the ridge you were just on.
One level, and somewhere to dry out
No stairs for tired legs, a washer and dryer for wet layers, and a car port to unload under.
